verdict.rationale: Wave's only documented event-triggered automation is a preset one: overdue-invoice reminders that fire automatically 3, 7 and 14 days after an invoice's due date (Pro plan). Auto-categorization of bank transactions is described, but nothing says users author the rules behind it. Recurring invoices are a recurring schedule, not an event trigger, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a general user-defined rule builder, custom triggers and actions beyond invoice reminders, user-authored categorization rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Schedule reminders to automatically deploy 3, 7, and 14 days after sent invoices are due, so you don't have to keep chasing customers.
Automatically send overdue reminders with Pro
